hooks.command: file_path=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.file_path // .new_file_path // empty'); if echo "$file_path" | grep -q '\.java$'; then cd smart-admin-api-java21-springboot3 && ./gradlew spotlessApply -q 2>/dev/null; fi

file_path=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | jq -r '.file_path // .new_file_path // empty'); if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(tsx?|jsx?)$'; then cd smart-admin-web-react && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; fi
if echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | grep -qiE '(DROP TABLE|TRUNCATE|DELETE FROM|ALTER TABLE.*DROP|rm -rf)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Destructive operation detected' >&2; exit 2; fi

Stop.name: Architecture Validation
Stop.description: Validates SmartAdmin layered architecture rules using ArchUnit

hooks.command: cd smart-admin-api-java21-springboot3 && echo '========================================' && echo 'Phase 1: ArchUnit Architecture Test' && echo '========================================' && ./gradlew :smartadmin-app:test --tests ArchitectureTest -q 2>&1 | tail -10

if [ -d .specs ] && command -v openspec >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '========================================' && echo 'Phase 2: OpenSpec Validation' && echo '========================================' && (openspec validate --specs 2>&1 | grep -v 'telemetry' || echo 'INFO: No specs to validate'); else echo 'INFO: OpenSpec not initialized (skip validation)'; fi

Stop.name: Quality Gate Summary
Stop.description: Displays comprehensive test coverage and quality metrics

hooks.command: cd smart-admin-api-java21-springboot3 && echo '========================================' && echo 'Phase 3: Quality Gate Summary' && echo '========================================' && echo 'Running comprehensive tests...' && ./gradlew :smartadmin-app:test -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(BUILD|test|SUCCESS|FAILED)' | tail -5 && echo '' && echo 'Test Coverage Report:' && (./gradlew :smartadmin-app:jacocoTestReport -q 2>&1 && find smartadmin-app/build/reports/jacoco/test -name 'index.html' -exec echo 'Coverage report: {}' \;) || echo 'Coverage report generation skipped'
